Adjust or import lyric cues

Cues follow the actual performance position. They pause when you stop. Song lyrics remain in their original language; English controls do not translate the lyrics.

No lyric offset

LRC times start at the first sounding beat of the current section. TXT lines are evenly spaced initially. Imported files stay in this browser.

Volume, scores and playing guide

Easy mode: keep your whole strumming hand visible, hold still to calibrate, then raise and strum down for each beat. Chord mode: choose chord numbers with your left hand, close your right hand and open it once to play. Holding it open will not repeat notes. Keys 1–6 choose chords; Space plays a beat. Use the on-screen cards without a camera.

Practice arrangements simplify the songs. Cue alignment is approximate and can be adjusted; it is not a claim of note-perfect transcription or an original artist recording. This repository includes traditional/classical repertoire and generic chord exercises.

About the project

MUSIC for Everyone explores accessible, camera-based music interaction. This Air Duet edition offers gesture-controlled guitar, chord selection, synchronized cues and keyboard alternatives. Hand tracking and audio run in your browser; camera permission is optional. The current public player focuses on guitar. Earlier project experiments included piano. This edition focuses on guitar.

Built with JavaScript, MediaPipe hand tracking and Web Audio. Read the English project notes ↗
